name: Juniper Networks
product_focus: Juniper SD-WAN, Mist WAN Assurance, SRX
evidence_summary: Juniper/Mist sources evidence AI-driven SD-WAN, WAN Assurance, monitoring and troubleshooting at the WAN edge.
cost_model: Quote-based hardware/subscription/support; managed delivery via partners/providers.
key_differentiators: Mist AI delivers WAN Assurance, providing AI-driven monitoring and troubleshooting at the WAN edge that few competitors match.
Strong story for buyers who want the WAN integrated with Mist-powered Wi-Fi and access network management.
Juniper SRX security platform integration provides native firewall capability for buyers standardised on Juniper.
best_fit_for: Enterprises already running Mist for Wi-Fi or access who want unified AI-driven operations across WAN and LAN.
Buyers prioritising observability and AI-assisted incident triage as a primary purchase criterion.
Organisations with strong network engineering capability who can take advantage of WAN Assurance telemetry.
watch_outs: SASE story is less mature than the SASE-led vendors; SSE capabilities have limited public evidence relative to category leaders.
Managed delivery is via partners; first-party managed service is not the primary model.
Cloud on-ramp and private backbone capabilities are less prominent than dedicated SASE platforms.
verification_notes: Capability matrix sourced from Netify internal vendor research (May 2026). Status grades reflect public source evidence only. Confirm via RFP. Qualitative fields (differentiators, best fit, watch-outs) are Netify editorial synthesis based on the evidence summary and capability profile; review before publishing. Extended dimensions (regions, clouds, AI, resilience, deployment speed) are indicative desk research grades from June 2026; confirm via RFP.

ai_capability.note: Mist AI and the Marvis conversational assistant; AI-native WAN assurance.

resilience.note: Session Smart Routing fails over per session with no tunnel re-establishment; HA clustering.
